dialogues.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Would you like to test yourself against me again?

choices.text: Oh, so you enjoy beetle battles too?

response.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
response.text: I wouldn't say that I "enjoy" it. I simply think that there is something to learn from many activities, so it wouldn't hurt to give it a go.

response.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
response.text: We often get a lot of non-combat-related requests mixed in with our high-difficulty commissions.

response.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
response.text: Solving mechanical puzzles, following clues to search for specific objects...

response.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
response.text: You never know when you might even encounter a commission that requires you to command other creatures to fulfill a certain objective.

response.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
response.text: I'm sure that you, of all people, would have experience with that?

choices.text: I shan't bother you for now.
